creatures.name: Bear, Black
creatures.description: A black bear is more likely to run from people or animals who invade their space, but they will protect their young. They are excellent climbers and can also run extremely fast.

creatures.name: Bear, Brown
creatures.description: Grizzlies are more aggressive than their black bear cousins, but only when threatened. They are quite fast but are not accomplished climbers, and have little fear of humans, often roaming into towns.

creatures.name: Bird of Prey
special: Special: Naturally birds can fly! Wings allow the bird to fly or glide for several hundred miles or as long as there are thermals to keep them aloft.
creatures.description: Representing hawks, falcons, and eagles, a bird of prey is a powerful companion for those who can tame it and a relentless, harrying foe for those who disturb it.

creatures.name: Mountain Lion
creatures.description: Solitary by nature, mountain lions avoid humans under most circumstances but can be tempted by loose livestock or pets. These powerful apex predators are extremely dangerous when cornered or protecting their young.

creatures.name: Shark
special: Special: Swimming! Any movement this creature does is at a swim speed, rather than walking (treat its movement rate as 0 on land).
creatures.description: Popular culture has these beasts as terrifying sea predators and well... they are.

creatures.name: Snake, Constrictor
creatures.description: Growing quite large, a constrictor snake can grapple and drown, crush, or suffocate a foe it can get its coils around.

creatures.name: Snake, Venomous
special: Damage: Bite (Brawn+1D). If the target of a bite from a venomous snake takes damage from the attack (stunned, wounded, or incapacitated), they suffer a 6D damage roll at the start of their next round.
creatures.description: Widespread throughout the world, venomous snakes have the potential to be deadly to even a large person (non-venomous snakes either flee or are constrictors).

creatures.name: Wolf
special: Special: Wolves are rarely alone. If you can see one there's usually a half-dozen more nearby.
creatures.description: The ultimate pack hunter, wolves are smart, and during lean times, very dangerous in packs.
